name: Shemariah
overview: Shemariah was a male member of the tribe of Judah, uniquely identified as the son of Rehoboam and Mahalath. His lineage places him within the royal family during the period recorded in 2 Chronicles. No additional notes expand on his life or role beyond his parentage.
namesAndTitles: The name Shemariah means 'YHWH guards, preserves,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning rooted in God's protective nature. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God but carries significant spiritual connotation.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Shemariah as the son of Rehoboam and Mahalath, linking him directly to the Davidic royal line. No other family relationships beyond these parents are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Shemariah's significance lies primarily in his royal descent as a son of Rehoboam, the king of Judah, which situates him within the unfolding history of Israel's monarchy. His mention in 2 Chronicles highlights the continuity of the Davidic line through Rehoboam's offspring. Although details about his personal deeds are not provided, his place in the genealogical record affirms God's ongoing covenant with David's descendants.
